discovery_notes: Follow-up 2 of B021 (DLP 2017); reuses keys from 227_b021 and 435_b099. 29 WebSearch calls, standard mode, blocked domains passed; all search_snippet. passiondlp Q3 2017 archive names PTN Jul/Aug and PTD 30 Sep pins as 'the three pins: X, Y, Z' (one pin per character). dein-dlrp Aug gives per-pin text for Snow White LE 150 set and the Christmas 4-pin set (releases 435 hold, via summary). dein-dlrp Dec names six princess-couple pins and a third Star Wars litho motif. dein-dlrp Apr names 4 Tsum Tsum pins. dein-dlrp Mar/May/Jun/Jul still teasers only; Sep/Nov not found. Resale-only facts (Yax LE 400) not recorded.
